Part 1: Loading range size, abundance and morphological data and merging
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load range size data
range_size <- read.csv("../data/range_sizes.csv")

# Load abundance data
abundance <- read.csv("../data/abundances.csv")

# Load morphological data if needed
morphology <- read.csv("../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data.csv")

# Merge datasets
merged_data <- merge(range_size, abundance, by.x = "Common.name", by.y = "Common.name") %>%
    distinct(Common.name, .keep_all = TRUE)
str(merged_data)
write.csv(merged_data, "../data/merged_range_abundance_data.csv")

# Load AVONET data
bulbul_specimens <- read.csv("../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#Merge Scientific.name column of merged_data and the Species2_eBird column of bulbul_specimens
final_data <- merge(merged_data, bulbul_specimens, by.x = "Scientific.name", by.y = "Species1_BirdLife")
str(final_data)
bulbuls <- final_data 

# Save the final bulbul data
write.csv(bulbuls, "../data/Bulbul_final_data.csv")
```

Part 2: Calculate trait variances for species with 4+ bulbul_specimens
```{r}
bulbuls_count <- table(bulbuls$Species2_eBird)
bulbuls <- bulbuls[bulbuls$Species2_eBird %in% names(bulbuls_count[bulbuls_count >= 5]), ]
str(bulbuls)

# Calculate trait variance for each species (one row per species)
trait_cols <- c("Species2_eBird", "area_square_miles", "Abundance.estimate",
                "Beak.Length_Culmen", "Beak.Length_Nares", 
                "Beak.Width", "Beak.Depth", "Tarsus.Length", 
                "Wing.Length", "Kipps.Distance", "Secondary1", "Hand.wing.Index", "Tail.Length")
bulbuls_var <- aggregate(. ~ Species2_eBird + area_square_miles + Abundance.estimate, 
                         data = bulbuls[, trait_cols], 
                         FUN = var, na.rm = TRUE)
str(bulbuls_var)

write.csv(bulbuls_count, "../data/Bulbul_specimen_counts.csv")
```

Part 3: Plotting trait variances against range size and abundance
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Remove highest range size outlier for better visualization
bulbuls_var <- bulbuls_var[bulbuls_var$area_square_miles < 7000000, ]

# Plot trait variances against range size
ggplot(bulbuls_var, aes(x = Tail.Length, y = area_square_miles)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "σ² Tail Length", y = "Range size in square miles") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("../results/TailLengthVar_vs_RangeSize_unlogged.png", width = 8, height = 5)

```

Part 4: Run an LM to test relationship between trait variance and range size
```{r}
lm_tail_length <- lm(scale(area_square_miles) ~ scale(Beak.Width), data = bulbuls_var)
summary(lm_tail_length)
```

Part 5: Instead of variance, model morphospace area vs range size and abundance
```{r}
# Select morphological traits for PCA
pca_traits <- bulbuls %>%
  select(
    Beak.Length_Culmen,
    Beak.Length_Nares,
    Beak.Width,
    Beak.Depth,
    Tarsus.Length,
    Wing.Length,
    Kipps.Distance,
    Tail.Length
  )

# Keep complete cases only
pca_complete <- pca_traits %>% drop_na()

# Keep matching metadata
meta_complete <- bulbuls %>%
  select(Species2_eBird, area_square_miles, Abundance.estimate) %>%
  slice(as.numeric(rownames(pca_complete)))

# Run PCA
pca_global <- prcomp(pca_complete, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
summary(pca_global)

# Calculate morphospace area (convex hull area) for each species
pca_scores <- data.frame(
  Species2_eBird        = meta_complete$Species2_eBird,
  area_square_miles     = meta_complete$area_square_miles,
  Abundance.estimate  = meta_complete$Abundance.estimate,
  PC1 = pca_global$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_global$x[, 2]
)

library(geometry)

morphospace_area <- pca_scores %>%
  group_by(Species2_eBird) %>%
  filter(n() >= 5) %>%   # enforce minimum sample size again
  summarise(
    morphospace_area = convhulln(
      cbind(PC1, PC2),
      options = "FA"
    )$vol,
    area_square_miles    = mean(area_square_miles, na.rm = TRUE),
    Abundance.estimate = mean(Abundance.estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_specimens          = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

str(morphospace_area)
write.csv(morphospace_area, "../data/Bulbul_morphospace_areas.csv")

# Plot morphospace area vs range size
ggplot(morphospace_area,
       aes(x = area_square_miles,
           y = (morphospace_area))) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Range size: square miles",
    y = "Log(Morphospace area: PC1–PC2)",
    title = "Species morphospace size vs geographic range size"
  )
```
